said on Tuesday that it is not in compliance with the minimum bid price requirement of the Nasdaq market.
This notification has no immediate effect on the listing of the company's Class A common shares, which will continue to trade uninterrupted on Nasdaq under the ticker "DOGZ."
The company said it has a compliance period of 180 calendar days, or until April 19, 2027, to regain Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement.

title: Dogness loses Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement compliance
